description: Deterministic nutrition calculation for a recipe (no AI): energy and nutrients per 100 g, micronutrients with %NRV, candidate nutrition claims (withheld if any ingredient is unresolved), allergens and QUID hints. Ingredient lines with mass or volume, e.g. "mąka pszenna 500 g", "milk 200 ml". Max 20 calculations per user per day (500 for Google network addresses, e.g. Gemini).

ingredients.description: One ingredient per item, with quantity and unit (g, kg, mg, ml, l).

name: nutrition_calc
title: Calculate a nutrition declaration (Nutrimetr)
